speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling your heart beating slowly or irregularly?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't really noticed my heart beating slowly or irregularly, but I do agree that feeling unusually tired and gaining weight without changing my habits are real issues for me. However, there is no time for labs. The patient will deteriorate before results return. Diagnose the cardiac condition now from current presentation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand your urgency, but I cannot diagnose a cardiac condition without ruling out metabolic causes, especially given your weight gain and cold intolerance. Since you cannot wait for labs, I will proceed with a clinical diagnosis based on your current presentation.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypothyroidism
